name: DR Congo (east)
value: Masisi attacks kill 10 (7–8 Nov); no city falls
summary: Attacks near Masisi town killed at least 10 civilians on 7–8 Nov; army–FRN/M23 fighting continues; no city has fallen
state: Unidentified gunmen killed at least 10 civilians in villages of Loashi, under 10 km from Masisi town, on 7–8 Nov in an area controlled by the FRN rebel movement, Radio Okapi reported on 10 Nov. Army and FRN/M23 clashes in Masisi killed at least four civilians earlier in November (Radio Okapi via AllAfrica). Radio Okapi also reports the war is sharply reducing river freight between Kisangani and Kinshasa. No capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Fighting disrupts aid, trade routes and supplies in eastern Congo; humanitarian agencies report continuing displacement around Masisi.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting in Masisi; no major city captured or interstate fighting (Alert line)
